headline: Troyes arrive on 5 straight defeats; Toulouse are 58.3% favourites
summary: Toulouse against Troyes has been moved to Sunday at 17:15, at the request of the Haute-Garonne prefecture, after protests were planned in the city on Saturday. On the pitch it points one way. Troyes arrive on 5 straight Ligue 1 defeats and have conceded 15 goals in that run; they sit 17th. Toulouse won 3-0 at Le Mans and create 2.06 expected goals a game. The market makes them 58.3% favourites against Troyes' 18.9%, rates Toulouse about a goal the better side, and sets a fair goal total of 2.79 — more likely than not a home win, not a certainty.
read: Toulouse host Troyes on Sunday at 17:15, a day later than planned after the Haute-Garonne prefecture moved the fixture because of demonstrations planned in the city. Toulouse are clear favourites — unbeaten in five and creating two expected goals a game — against a Troyes side that has lost all five of its last matches and conceded 15 goals in the process.

facts.fact: The LFP confirmed the Toulouse–Troyes match has been moved from Saturday 24 October to Sunday 25 October at 17:15, at the request of the Haute-Garonne prefecture.
facts.meaning: Both teams get an extra day's preparation, and the game will be played in a heavy security context in Toulouse rather than a normal Saturday evening.

facts.fact: Troyes have lost all five of their last five Ligue 1 matches.
facts.meaning: They arrive with no win in over a month and no point to show for their last five games — the single biggest reason the market makes them clear outsiders.

facts.fact: Toulouse won 3-0 away at Le Mans on 16 October.
facts.meaning: They come in off their most comfortable result of the run, and they have scored in every one of their last five league games.

facts.fact: Toulouse are priced as 58.3% favourites — more than three times Troyes' 18.9% chance.
facts.meaning: More likely than not a Toulouse win, but far from certain: roughly three games in five, with the draw at 22.8%.

facts.fact: The market rates Toulouse about 0.86 goals the better side, a fair handicap line of -0.86.
facts.meaning: A Toulouse win by roughly one goal is the central expectation — the margin, not just the result, is what is being priced.

facts.fact: Toulouse have averaged 2.06 expected goals across their last five league games.
facts.meaning: Chance creation is the strongest part of their game — they are not winning on luck, they are generating real volume.

facts.fact: Troyes have conceded 15 goals across those five defeats.
facts.meaning: They are shipping three a game on average, so Toulouse's chance creation meets the league's leakiest recent defence.

facts.fact: The market's fair goal line is 2.89, just under three goals.
facts.meaning: Goals are expected, but the market leans slightly to the under side of three rather than to a rout.

sources.fact: The LFP confirmed the Toulouse v Troyes Ligue 1 match was postponed from Saturday 24 October to Sunday 25 October at the request of the Haute-Garonne prefecture.
The postponement was requested because of a new national mobilisation and demonstrations planned for Saturday in Toulouse.
The match is a Ligue 1 fixture counting for the 8th matchday, originally scheduled for Saturday at 17:15.
The rescheduled match is set for Sunday 25 October at 17:15, in agreement with the broadcaster Ligue1+.
The fixture is due to be played at the Stadium de Toulouse.
